entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 532-aa sequence has 76.8% identity and 99.8% coverage to reviewed archaeal CTP synthase Q12WH5.
Homolog annotations assign EC 6.3.4.2; ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia.
Related curated homologs are annotated as homotetramers and assigned to de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis.

entities.name: CTP synthesis from UTP
observations: Rhea RHEA:26426: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O = CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+).
Alternative ammonia-dependent reaction: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP = CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+), Rhea RHEA:16597.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: Curated high-identity homologs place CTP synthase in pyrimidine metabolism and de novo CTP biosynthesis.
